description:
This file defines the `OutputStyle` class in the `ScssPhp
ull` namespace, providing constants and static methods to manage output styles ('expanded' and 'compressed') for the SCSS PHP compiler, including conversion between string and enum representations.

classes.name: OutputStyle
classes.description: Final class providing constants and static methods to handle SCSS output styles, supporting conversion between string representations and internal enum-like values.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string ('expanded' or 'compressed') to the corresponding constant. Throws an InvalidArgumentException for invalid input.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the given output style constant.
